adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`, the subject is built with `name: this.calEvent.attendees[0].name`. The diff does not establish that the subject is intended to reference the newly added guest(s); it may be intended to reference the primary attendee/booker (often stored as the first attendee), which is consistent with many booking-related email subjects. Additionally, newly added guests are created with `name: ""` in `addGuests.handler.ts`, so even if the intent were to use a newly added guest's name, that data is not available from this diff. Thus the claim that this is a definite misleading bug is not verifiable from the changes shown.
